Define a warning threshold value for disk utilization. A warning alert is triggered when the utilization exceeds the threshold value.

Example: 60

utilizationCriticalThreshold.description: Define a critical threshold value for disk utilization. A critical alert is triggered when the utilization exceeds the threshold value. The utilization threshold value is represented as a percentage.

Define a warning threshold value for free disk space. A warning alert is triggered when the free disk space exceeds the threshold value.

Example: 40

freeDiskCriticalThreshold.description:
Define a critical threshold value for free disk space. A critical alert is triggered when the free disk space exceeds the threshold value.

Example: 80.

The free disk threshold value is represented in MB.

actions.description:
- Supported actions
   - ASSIGN MONITORINGTEMPLATE
   - ASSIGN KNOWLEDGEARTICLE
   - Assign Availability Rule

   - Assign Jobs

  -  For Assign Availability Rule  , item value is AND
  -  For ASSIGN CUSTOMATTRIBUTES, item value is tagName[value='tagValue']
  -  For all others this is  number in string eg  "12345"
- Scenarios for Custom attributes item values in response payload
   - New TagName : New Tag created with given Name and Tag Value, and Assigned. - Id of New Tag Value added to response
   - Old TagName and New Tag Value : New Tag Value added to Tag and Assigned - Id of New Tag Value added to response.

items.title: action
items.description:
Refers to the actions performed on the filtered resources. Select at least one of the following actions:
- Assign Monitoring Templates
- Assign Knowledge Base Articles
- Assign Availability Rule
- Assign Custom Attributes
- Assign Jobs
- Assign Credentials

Examples: "ASSIGN MONITORINGTEMPLATE" and "ASSIGN KNOWLEDGEARTICLE"

parameters.description: Template configuration parameters. These would be mandatory attributes in case the template has been configured to have configuration parameters for the "ASSIGN MONITORINGTEMPLATE" action.

resourceType.description:
Type of resource.
Example: DEVICE, VOLUME, VPN, XENSERVER

clientMatchingType.description:
- The clientMatchingType field is optional and when not passed defaults to the following   "clientMatchingType": "ALL"
- The clientMatchingType field is applicable at partner-level DMP only.
- If clientMatchingType EXCLUDE/INCLUDE, then the clients field is mandatory.
- On policy update, if clientMatchingType is not passed then clientMatchingType will be updated to ALL and client selection will be removed.

searchQuery.description: Search query string for filtering resources.

parentPolicy.description: ID of the parent policy from which this policy is being cloned. This numerical field can be given as part of payload to create a child policy.

uid.description: Unique identifier string for the policy.

systemQuery.description: System-generated query string for additional filtering criteria. System-generated query string containing the parent policy query. User-defined search query will append to this system query with AND condition as present in UI.

completeSearchQuery.description: Combined search query including both user-defined and system-generated criteria.

parentPolicyUID.description: Unique identifier string of the parent policy

customized.description: Indicates whether the policy has been customized from its parent.

globalPolicy.description: Indicates whether this is a global policy or tenant-specific.

parent.description: Add a device group as child under an existing device group (parent). This field is mandatory while adding a child device group to parent device group.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).
